methodology.grouping: case group (dev/fresh) is assigned from the source dataset file
methodology.invalid_handling: invalid outputs are excluded from classification rates but reported as counts/rates over N; accuracy is valid-only and explicitly named accuracy_valid_only
methodology.raw_hashing: file-byte SHA-256 (Get-FileHash) of each aggregate raw report under evaluation/results/poc_3f_e0/; per-case raw provider envelopes are not persisted by the harness (aggregate reports only), so per-case raw_report_sha256 remains null
methodology.sanitization: summary contains no API keys, no Authorization headers, no raw provider envelopes, no full question or evidence text
methodology.zero_denominator: ratios with zero denominator are null, never 0.0
